note: Recast from species entry 280 of the Fauna Sinica, original in Chinese; the soldier only is recorded, the alate and worker not being described; the measurement table is reproduced item by item (in the original a few entries give a single value, e.g. postmentum length printed as 0.71—0.71 with a mean of 0.72; these are reproduced as printed and the point is noted).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow to deep yellow, slightly paler in the middle of the front; labrum yellow; antenna yellowish brown, the apical segments darker; mandible apex black, base yellowish brown; thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow, the pronotum slightly darker; body sparsely covered with fine hairs. Head oval and flattened, distinctly contracted anteriorly and gradually forming a sloping face; head longer than wide, widest at the middle, posterior margin rounded; fontanelle indistinct. Labrum lingulate, longer than wide, widest at the base, with several bristles regularly arranged along the two sides. Mandibles slender and sabre-shaped, slightly curved apically, slightly shorter than the head; the inner margin of the left mandible with 1 large tooth in the anterior quarter and 1 small tooth near the base; the inner margin of the right mandible with 1 weakly developed small tooth in the quarter near the apex and 1 small tooth near the base. Antenna 15 segments: segment 1 cylindrical and longest, segment 2 cylindrical and slightly shorter than 1, segment 3 squarish and shortest, segments 4—11 increasing segment by segment and club-shaped, the terminal segment largest and oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head width; anterior margin projecting forwards as a lobe with a median notch; posterior margin contracted at the sides, slightly depressed medially. Measurements (mm, soldier, range/mean): head length to the mandible apex 1.79—1.89/1.82; head length to the mandible base 1.11—1.14/1.12; head width 1.04—1.11/1.06; head height 0.79—0.86/0.82; labrum length 0.29—0.36/0.32; labrum width 0.21/0.21; left mandible length 0.71—0.75/0.72; postmentum length 0.71/0.72; postmentum width 0.50—0.54/0.52; pronotum length 0.46—0.50/0.47; pronotum width 0.71—0.75/0.72; hind tibia length 1.07—1.11/1.08.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Head oval and flattened, the front contracted into a sloping face, longer than wide; antenna 15 segments; inner margin of the left mandible with 1 large tooth in the anterior quarter, the right mandibular tooth very weakly developed; pronotum narrower than the head width, its anterior margin projecting as a lobe. Distribution known only from Yarong, Medog, Xizang (elevation 1000 m).
